g:HTMLPanel.p: Contextual feedback messages: Alert with a type, dismissable with a close button.

d:Example.heading: Types
d:Example.description: Set `type` to one of the eight `AlertType`s. The default is `WARNING`.

d:Example.heading: Additional content
d:Example.description: An `Alert` holds any widget. Give links the `alert-link` class so they match the alert's color.

d:Example.heading: Dismissable
d:Example.description: `dismissable` adds a close button; `fade` animates the close. Closing removes the alert from its parent, and `addClosedHandler` tells you when it is gone.
